extDescription.message: A safe, fully offline region-select OCR — no data ever leaves your browser.

popupDescription.message: Click the button or press $KEY$ to select a region on the page for OCR.

viewerDropHint.message: Drag & drop, Ctrl+V to paste, or click the button to select

viewerSelectHint.message: Drag to select the region for OCR (Esc to cancel)

statusCannotRun.message: Cannot run OCR on this page (chrome:// etc.)

optionsDescription.message: Customize region select OCR behavior. Settings sync via your Google account.

optionShowResultAlert.message: Show OCR result in an alert dialog after completion

optionShowResultAlertHint.message: When enabled, the recognized text is shown in a browser alert dialog in addition to being copied to the clipboard.

optionDebugMode.message: Debug mode (save the image sent to OCR)

optionDebugModeHint.message: When enabled, the cropped image (with adjacent-color padding) sent to DEIM is stored temporarily. Use "Show last screenshot" below to inspect it.

debugCropEmpty.message: No saved image yet. Enable debug mode and run OCR first.

shortcutsDescription.message: You can change the keyboard shortcut from Chrome's built-in settings page.

shortcutsHint.message: chrome://extensions/shortcuts cannot be opened via a link, so it is opened via this button.

cleaningRulesDescription.message: Applied to OCR results in order (top to bottom) via String.replace just before copying to clipboard. Invalid patterns are skipped automatically.

emptyRulesMessage.message: No rules yet. Click "+ Add Rule" to create one.

importDuplicateConfirm.message: The following rules already exist. Overwrite them?

importErrorMessage.message: Failed to load file. Please check that it is valid JSON.

testingDescription.message: Apply current rules to sample text and preview the result.

rulesHowToDescription.message: Rules use JavaScript RegExp syntax. Flags: g (global), i (case-insensitive), m (multiline), s (dot matches newline), etc. The replacement field supports escape sequences \t (tab), \n (newline), \r, \\ and capture group back-references like $1.

seedRuleSpaceComment.message: Removes unwanted spaces inserted by OCR between Japanese characters

seedRuleCommaComment.message: Useful for removing digit grouping commas in invoices and financial documents (e.g. 1,000,000 → 1000000)

seedRuleMultiNewlineComment.message: Collapses consecutive blank lines into a single newline

seedRuleNewlineComment.message: Removes all line breaks to join everything into a single line

aiDescription.message: Process OCR output with Chrome's built-in offline AI to reformat or transform it.

aiWhyOfflineBody.message: Starting with Chrome 138, Google's Gemini Nano AI is built into the browser and runs entirely on your device.

aiWhyOfflineItem2.message: OCR'd text is never sent to any server

aiWhyOfflineItem3.message: Your prompts stay on your machine too

aiWhyOfflineNote.message: Note: The AI model (~several GB) is downloaded automatically on first use, then served from cache.

aiDisclaimerBody.message: This feature uses Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano. Its behavior and data-handling policies are determined by Google. If Google ever changes how it works (for example, moving some processing online), this extension cannot control that. Please review the official documentation below for the latest information before enabling.

optionAIActivePromptHint.message: OCR text (after cleaning rules are applied) will be passed to the AI.

emptyPromptsMessage.message: No prompts yet. Click "+ Add prompt" to create one.

promptContentLabel.message: Content ({{text}} will be replaced with the OCR result)

aiAvailabilityUnsupported.message: Gemini Nano is not available in this browser (Chrome 138+ required).

aiAvailabilityUnavailable.message: Gemini Nano is currently unavailable. Please update Chrome to the latest version.

aiAvailabilityDownload.message: The AI model will be downloaded on first use (~several GB).

seedPromptCleanupContent.message:
Clean up unnecessary line breaks and whitespace in the following OCR result and produce a naturally flowing text. Do not change the meaning.

{{text}}

seedPromptJsonContent.message:
From the following OCR result, extract numeric values (amounts, dates, quantities, etc.) and output them as a JSON object. No prose explanation.

{{text}}

seedPromptMarkdownContent.message:
Format the following OCR result as a Markdown table. Output only the table.

{{text}}

seedPromptTranslateContent.message:
Translate the following text into natural Japanese. Output only the translation.

{{text}}

toastSelectionInstruction.message: Drag to select the region you want to OCR (Esc to cancel)

alertResultCopied.message: OCR Result ($COUNT$ chars) — Copied to clipboard

alertResultCopyFailed.message: OCR Result ($COUNT$ chars) — Failed to copy to clipboard

offscreenJustification.message: Hosts ONNX Runtime Web (WASM) in a Web Worker for local inference
